text: Wore these for a family gathering and received compliments all evening. So light I forgot I had them on — the geometric band is gorgeous up close. Packaging was beautiful too.
The cocoa fabric and white geometry are exquisite. They sit perfectly and paired wonderfully with a deep maroon saree. You can tell these are finished by hand.
Stunning forest-green studs. The gold rim is clever and catches light without shouting. Only wish I had ordered a second pair for gifting.
These little hearts transformed my everyday look. Light enough to wear for hours, yet the woven centre has real character. Worth every rupee.
The mustard and burgundy pairing is so fine you need to look closely. A small pair with enormous presence — and the gold drop sways just enough.
Wore these to a family celebration and they looked considered from every angle. Compact, polished, and they never irritated.
Beautiful craftsmanship. Took a week to arrive but the wait was justified. Lighter than expected — a plus for long events.
Love the burgundy hearts. My partner wears them daily — the posts never irritate and they look expensive far beyond the price.
